sloka: स तं दृष्ट्वा महात्मानं राघवस्तु विसिष्मिये।वानरान् सान्त्वयित्वा ऽथ विभीषणमुवाच ह ।। ६.७१.११ ।।
transliteration: sa taṁ dṛṣṭvā mahātmānaṁ rāghavastu visiṣmiye।vānarān sāntvayitvā 'tha vibhīṣaṇamuvāca ha ।। 6.71.11 ।।

translations.english: Raghava the great, seeing the form of a huge body, was amazed, reassured by the Vanaras, and spoke to Vibheeshana.
